tables: CREATE TABLE metadata (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE archives (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            product TEXT NOT NULL,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            size INTEGER NOT NULL,
            mtime_ns INTEGER NOT NULL,
            archive_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            archive_version TEXT NOT NULL,
            product_version TEXT NOT NULL,
            verified INTEGER NOT NULL,
            indexed_members INTEGER NOT NULL
        )

CREATE TABLE assets (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            archive_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES archives(id),
            logical_path TEXT NOT NULL,
            folder TEXT NOT NULL,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            extension TEXT NOT NULL,
            asset_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
            curated_category TEXT NOT NULL,
            civilization TEXT NOT NULL,
            object_class TEXT NOT NULL,
            object_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            size INTEGER NOT NULL,
            raw_name TEXT NOT NULL,
            verification TEXT NOT NULL,
            storage TEXT NOT NULL,
            encryption TEXT NOT NULL,
            preview_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_generated',
            preview_path TEXT
        )

CREATE TABLE resolved_assets(
  id INT,
  logical_path TEXT,
  folder TEXT,
  name TEXT,
  extension TEXT,
  asset_kind TEXT,
  curated_category TEXT,
  civilization TEXT,
  object_class TEXT,
  object_type TEXT,
  size INT,
  raw_name TEXT,
  preview_status TEXT,
  preview_path TEXT,
  product TEXT,
  archive TEXT,
  archive_path TEXT,
  provider_archive_id TEXT,
  archive_version TEXT,
  product_version TEXT,
  verified INT,
  provider_count
)

CREATE TABLE object_types(
  object_class TEXT,
  object_type TEXT,
  resource_count,
  model_count,
  representative_model
)
